english_sub: HANNO: THE POPE'S ELEPHANT FROM KOCHI

topic.title: Hanno, the Pope's elephant (1514)
topic.angle: A young white elephant, believed shipped from Kochi, gifted by King Manuel I of Portugal to Pope Leo X; knelt before the Pope; died 1516; the Pope wrote his epitaph; bones found 1962
key_facts: In 1514 King Manuel I of Portugal sent a young white elephant to Pope Leo X
Historians (e.g. Silvio Bedini, The Pope's Elephant) believe he came from India, likely via Kochi
Named Hanno (Annone), he knelt before the Pope and became a favourite in Rome
He fell ill and died in 1516; Leo X composed his epitaph; Raphael is said to have painted a memorial
Bones believed to be Hanno's were found in the Vatican in 1962
sources: Silvio A. Bedini, The Pope's Elephant (1997)
